headline: Sensex gains over 500 points as Nifty crosses 25,250 led by FMCG and banking stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign fund inflows and strong FII buying supported the market rally.
FMCG and banking sector stocks drove major gains in benchmark indices.
Strong early trade momentum helped Sensex climb over 500 points.
Heavyweights like ITC, Bharti Airtel, and Asian Paints led the upside move.
whatHappening: Sensex rose over 500 points, while Nifty50 closed near 25,291.
SEBI set up a sub-group under PMAC to review key IPO norms, headed by NSE's Ashishkumar Chauhan.
Economists urged FM Sitharaman to retain capital gains tax on equities ahead of Budget 2027-28.
Lakshmi Venu sought partition of family assets amid an ongoing TVS family feud.
summary: Indian markets ended significantly higher on November 16, 2026, backed by solid foreign fund inflows and strong gains in FMCG and banking stocks. Sensex rallied over 500 points to push Nifty past 25,250. Max Healthcare, ITC, Bharti Airtel, and Asian Paints were among the major gainers during trading.
